message.sourceofmystery.altar.no_recipe: [No matching recipe] Drop the materials within %s blocks of the altar
message.sourceofmystery.boss.awakening: A Dragon Soul and the five element sources have been offered at the Mystery Altar. The power of the Heavenly Dao begins to stir...
message.sourceofmystery.boss.countdown: The Heavenly Dao descends in %s seconds...
message.sourceofmystery.boss.lightning: The heavens are torn asunder by thunder!
message.sourceofmystery.boss.arrived: The Divine Heavenly Dao has descended!
commands.sourceofmystery.somenergy.succe: Set the Mystery Energy of %s player(s) to %s
book.sourceofmystery.guide.name: Source of Mystery Guide
book.sourceofmystery.guide.subtitle: Source Of Mystery
book.sourceofmystery.guide.landing: Welcome to the $(l)Source of Mystery$().$(br2)Start by mining Mystery Source Ore, forge ever stronger gear at the Mystery Altar, defeat the $(l)Dragon Soul$() that rises after the Ender Dragon, and finally offer a Dragon Soul and the five element sources at the altar to face the $(l)Divine Heavenly Dao$().
advancements.sourceofmystery.root.title: Source of Mystery
advancements.sourceofmystery.root.descri: Mine Mystery Source Ore, smelt Mystery Ingots and craft a Mystery Altar
advancements.sourceofmystery.mysterious_: Use a Mystery Altar for the first time. Next: drop iron ingots, Mystery Ingots and a diamond sword (or diamond) next to it
advancements.sourceofmystery.origin_powe: Obtain the Mystery Chestplate or Mystery Sword. Next: gather netherite ingots for the Spirit Source tier
advancements.sourceofmystery.probe_spiri: Obtain the Spirit Source Chestplate or Spirit Source Sword. Next: collect wither skeleton skulls and nether stars
advancements.sourceofmystery.touch_dark_: Obtain the Dark Source Chestplate or Dark Source Sword. Next: slay the Ender Dragon, then defeat the Dragon Soul that follows for a Dragon Soul
advancements.sourceofmystery.can_slayer_: Obtain the Origin Dragon Chestplate or Origin Dragon Sword. Next: get another Dragon Soul and one each of the Wood, Gold, Water, Fire and Earth Sources, then right-click the Mystery Altar holding the Dragon Soul to summon the Divine Heavenly Dao
advancements.sourceofmystery.provoke_hea: Be within 100 blocks when the Divine Heavenly Dao descends. Defeat it for Heavenly Dao Fragments
advancements.sourceofmystery.kill_divine: Defeat the Divine Heavenly Dao. Next: forge Divine gear from Heavenly Dao Fragments
advancements.sourceofmystery.become_heav: Obtain Divine Punishment or Divine Blessing
message.sourceofmystery.altar.summon_bus: The Heavenly Dao is already descending. Only one summoning can run in a dimension at a time.
message.sourceofmystery.dragon_soul.roar: The Dragon Soul stirs, and the heavens rumble...
message.sourceofmystery.altar.summon_mis: The offering is missing: %s. To summon the Divine Heavenly Dao, hold a Dragon Soul and carry one each of the Wood, Gold, Water, Fire and Earth Sources.
subtitles.sourceofmystery.divine_heavenl: Divine Heavenly Dao smashes the ground
